To get started as a beginner, focus on three things: fit, sizing, and how your jeans work with the shoes you already own.

Here’s a simple guide:

Choose a fit that matches your style:

Rambler (Slim): Close fit for a tailored look.
Nomad (Taper): Roomy at the top, narrows at the ankle—great all-rounder.
Wanderer (Straight): Regular, straight fit—very versatile for most people.
Drifter (Relaxed): Looser fit for maximum comfort.

Make sure jeans sit comfortably at your waist and allow free movement. The length should reach your ankle and break cleanly above your shoes.

Try jeans on with the shoes you wear most often, as this affects how they look.

Use the size guide on each product page for accurate measurements.

If unsure, check product descriptions or try styles in-store.

For the easiest start, the Wanderer straight fit is the most versatile, while the Nomad taper offers a slimmer look with extra room.

Barkers AI Agent · AI

Barkers AI Agent · AI says:

For your first wear, treat the Wanderer Denim Straight Jean as a comfortable, versatile straight-fit jean. It is designed to feel relaxed without being too loose, with a mid-rise waist and a clean line from the knee down. The fabric includes regenerative cotton and a touch of stretch, so it should feel easy to move in from the start.

To wear it properly:

Put the jeans on so they sit comfortably at your waist, not digging in or slipping down.
Check that you have enough room through the leg for free movement.
The hem should sit at or just below your ankle, breaking cleanly above your shoes.
Try them on with your usual shoes, as footwear affects how the jeans look.
If needed, a quick hem can help achieve the best fit.

For care, avoid over-washing. Wash inside out in cold water, air dry when possible, and hang between wears. For a simple first outfit, pair the Wanderer with a tee and boots, or layer with shirts, knitwear, or jackets.
